As a meat production worker at Van Loon , you'll be part of a close-knit team and help package high-quality meat products for stores and restaurants. What will you be doing? - Packaging meat according to customer orders - Working in a team of 2-6 colleagues - Performing manual tasks that machines cannot handle - Processing seasonal products (such as BBQ or holiday assortments) What do we offer? - Gross hourly wage of €14.99 - Working in an international work environment - A stable job with room for growth Location Beilen, Netherlands Join us at Van Loon to help create delicious products and grow as part of a dynamic and friendly team! Language Skills Communicative proficiency in English. Housing and Transportation - Free shipping to the Netherlands - Comfortable accommodations in double rooms close to work Health Care Subsidy and Insurance - Additional healthcare allowance of €131.00 per month - Everyone who works in the Netherlands through us is insured Loyalty Program We have developed an online loyalty program specifically for our employees: Flexspecialists LOYALTY. You earn points for every hour you work. You can use these points for personal development or leisure activities (health and recreation). Additional information We provide support from Polish-speaking coordinators in the Netherlands, transportation to and from work, assistance with applying for a BSN number (SOFI number), and we ensure that wages are paid correctly and on time (weekly).
